compute_jacobians: compute the jacobians of ys with respect to xs using parallel_for gradients
compute_hessians: compute the hessians of ys with respect to xs with optional no_backprop mode
get_tensor_shape: get the shape list of a tensor resolving dynamic dimensions as tf.Tensor scalars
wrap_gradient_estimator: wrap a gradient loss function to return a surrogate loss and jacobian dictionary
add_grads_to_jacobians: add gradients of y with respect to variables to an existing jacobians dictionary
